texts.content: Ensure that all chassis components are available and in good condition.
Verify alignment of the base frame before proceeding with assembly.
Install the engine mount securely following the specified torque settings.
Connect the wiring harness carefully to ensure proper insulation.
Position the door panels accurately using the alignment fixtures.
Secure the panels with the designated fasteners to prevent rattling.
Check all seals for proper fit to prevent water ingress during operations.
Perform a thorough quality inspection of paint and finish for any defects.
Measure engine output under standardized conditions and record the data.
Note any deviations from expected performance levels and report them.
Test the operation of all airbags and seatbelt sensors in a controlled environment.
Verify that emergency braking systems respond within the required time frame.
Inspect the vehicle exterior for dents, scratches, or paint inconsistencies.
Verify that the interior fittings meet quality and safety standards.
Complete all necessary inspection checklists and accurately log the results.
Approve the vehicle for delivery if all quality criteria are satisfactorily met.
